environment.browserServer: Production Node build served locally with generated auth secret; agent UI, Calls and billing disabled

acceptedDecision.source: Matthieu in the implementation conversation, 31 October 2026
acceptedDecision.policy: Unsubscribing suppresses optional issue updates. Assignments and direct mentions remain independent, subject to account notification settings. Creator subscription remains; commenting/reacting does not resubscribe.

evidence: Three real Better Auth sessions include two independently signed-in browser contexts for Bob. The same subscription and one owned reaction appear after the second login.
Separate users share an emoji reaction without replacing one another; subscriptions persist after reload.
Actor ownership is derived server-side. Admins cannot replace subscriber lists or inject another user into a reaction command.
A post-commit reaction-removal response is dropped in the browser; reload restores the exact pending command. Retry does not resurrect the removed reaction or duplicate the outbox event.
Unsubscribing preserves discussion and suppresses optional notification eligibility. Later comment producers still emit direct mention events.

The server delivery policy independently admits authorized direct mentions/assignments and applies current per-channel notification settings. Self-events, revoked membership/private-team access and inactive issues are ineligible.
Concurrent exact requests commit one state transition/event. A fresh desired-state no-op emits no event or revision. Equivalent emoji presentation forms deduplicate.

checks: Concurrent exact retries and two readers
Unsubscribe, delayed replay and later mention event
Multiple actors, concurrent comment edits and issue-description reactions
Forged ownership and subscriber-list edit rejection
Invalid emoji and deleted/missing comment rejection
Live private-team, session, workspace and scope revocation
Account notification channel settings and self-event suppression
Atomic audit-failure rollback
Owned API-key/delegated actors and issue lifecycle gates
Equivalent emoji presentation forms

postgresRegression.note: The broad run had long execution stalls, followed by WebSocket connection loss and timeouts. Both failed cases were FOR-47 tests and passed in the subsequent complete 10-case targeted run. All 104 earlier issue regression cases passed. This was not a clean single broad invocation.

appRegression.note: The broad run experienced long execution stalls. Two timed-out UI cases and the file whose worker failed to start were rerun together: 26 tests passed in issue-list.test.tsx, workspace/-teams.test.tsx and views-page.test.tsx. No unrelated product code was changed to address these interruptions.
